CFML Language Reference: Functions

ArraySum

Adds up all the elements of a one-dimensional array of numbers.

Category

Array functions

Syntax

ArraySum(array)

Parameters

array
A one-dimensional array of numeric values.

Returns

The total as a number; 0 for an empty array.

Usage

A non-numeric element throws an Expression exception ("Non-numeric value in array").

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Cart = ArrayNew(1)>
<CFSET Cart[1] = 19.95>
<CFSET Cart[2] = 4.50>
<CFSET Cart[3] = 129.00>
<CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<CFLOOP INDEX="i" FROM="1" TO="#ArrayLen(Cart)#">
<TR><TD>Item #i#</TD><TD ALIGN="RIGHT">#DollarFormat(Cart[i])#</TD></TR>
</CFLOOP>
<TR><TH>Total</TH><TH ALIGN="RIGHT">#DollarFormat(ArraySum(Cart))#</TH></TR>
</TABLE>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

ArrayAvg, ArrayMin, ArrayMax
